bookingOpens: Online through the Book a Table button on the restaurant's website (Tebi), or by phone, WhatsApp (+31 6 58839469) or email (info@larsamsterdam.nl). Lunch Thursday to Saturday from 12pm; dinner Tuesday to Saturday from 6pm; closed Sunday and Monday.
groups: On days the restaurant is normally closed, it takes groups of 20 or more on request; private dining and events by enquiry.
